title: Fleet catalog entry
description: How one fleet server advertises itself to the Edison marketplace. Each servers/<id>/catalog-entry.json is one entry; edison-watch's sync upserts these into scripts/marketplace_connectors.json. Keep in lockstep with the structural checks in aggregate.py and with edison-watch's index_entry()/server_file() in scripts/generate_marketplace_entries.py.

id.description: Stable connector id; must equal the server directory name and the icon basename.

edison_hosted.description: First-party server Edison itself hosts and operates. Drives the Edison-hosted badge. Omit or false for OSS/self-host-only servers.

url.description: Public streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint. Ends in /mcp.

auth.description: edison-watch mount auth mode. 'token' resolves {PLACEHOLDER}s from template_fields.env; 'oauth' is 401-discovered; 'none' is open; 'edison-jwt' means Edison mints a per-user JWT and injects it (first-party servers only; requires edison_hosted, no user token). The fleet server's bearer mode maps onto 'token'.

headers.description: Required when auth == 'token'. Values may contain {PLACEHOLDER} tokens resolved from template_fields.env.

template_fields.description: Required when auth == 'token'. Install-time fields the user supplies.

icon.description: Icon filename, co-located in this server directory; sync copies it into frontend-v2/public/marketplace/icons/.
